about.tagline: Hotkeys, QuickMenus and remote control for Windows
about.notElevated: without administrator rights (hotkeys won't work over elevated windows)
about.tipsText:
• In the QuickMenu: left click runs and closes, right click runs and keeps it open, middle click edits the command (Ctrl + middle click edits the menu).
• With the keyboard: arrows, Enter (Shift + Enter keeps it open), Esc and each item's first letter.
• Pressing the QuickMenu hotkey again closes it.
• Esc cancels countdowns (shutdown, waits, messages).
• Ctrl + Alt + Home opens K-Desktop and Ctrl + Alt + End exits (configurable).
about.languagesText: To translate K-Desktop copy Languages\en.json with the language code (e.g. fr.json), translate the texts and save it in Languages or in %APPDATA%\K-Desktop 5\Languages. It will show up in Settings.
